
@media(min-width:1000px){#igt-auth-card{width:min(460px,100%)}#igt-workspace>section{max-width:1100px!important}}
@media(max-width:600px){#igt-registration-panel{padding:10px!important}#igt-registration-form{margin:10px auto!important;padding:19px!important}#igt-reg-title{font-size:24px!important}}
</style>
<meta name="theme-color" content="#071b35">
<style id="igt-performance-v12">
html{text-size-adjust:100%;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%;}
#portal-hero .hero-slide{contain:layout paint;}
#igt-workspace,#igt-inbox{overscroll-behavior:contain;}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*::before,*::after{scroll-behavior:auto!important;animation-duration:.01ms!important;animation-iteration-count:1!important;transition-duration:.01ms!important;}}
</style>
<style id="igt-auth-no-flash">body.igt-auth-pending>*:not(#igt-auth-gate):not(#ib-igt-startup-splash){visibility:hidden!important}</style>
</head><body>
<div id="igt-auth-gate" hidden role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="igt-auth-title">
 <form id="igt-auth-card">
  <div style="font-size:12px;letter-spacing:1.5px;font-weight:700;color:#b18a35">RÉPUBLIQUE DÉMOCRATIQUE DU CONGO</div>
  <h2 id="igt-auth-title">Annuaire numérique de l’inspection générale du Travail</h2>
  <p>Retrouver un agent par son nom ou son numéro matricule.</p>
  <label for="igt-auth-email">Adresse e-mail</label><input id="igt-auth-email" type="email" autocomplete="username" required placeholder="nom@exemple.com">
  <label for="igt-auth-password">Mot de passe</label><input id="igt-auth-password" type="password" autocomplete="current-password" required placeholder="Votre mot de passe">
  <div id="igt-auth-confirm-wrap" hidden><label for="igt-auth-confirm">Confirmer le nouveau mot de passe</label><input id="igt-auth-confirm" type="password" autocomplete="new-password" placeholder="Répétez le nouveau mot de passe"></div>
  <button id="igt-auth-submit" type="submit">Se connecter</button>
  <button id="igt-forgot-password" type="button" style="width:100%;margin-top:10px;padding:9px;border:0;background:transparent;color:#0d4772;text-decoration:underline;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer">Mot de passe oublié ?</button>
  <button id="igt-open-registration" type="button" style="width:100%;margin-top:8px;padding:12px;border:1px solid #0d4772;border-radius:9px;background:#fff;color:#0d4772;font-weight:700;font-size:14px">Créer mon compte agent</button>
  <div id="igt-auth-message" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>
  
 </form>
</div>
<div id="igt-registration-panel" hidden role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="igt-reg-title" style="position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:1000000;background:#061a30ee;overflow:auto;padding:18px;box-sizing:border-box">
 <form id="igt-registration-form" style="max-width:480px;margin:25px auto;background:#fff;color:#172334;border-radius:18px;padding:24px;box-shadow:0 20px 70px #0006;font-family:Arial,sans-serif">
  <div style="font-size:11px;letter-spacing:1px;font-weight:700;color:#b18a35">RÉPUBLIQUE DÉMOCRATIQUE DU CONGO</div>
  <div style="font-size:13px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.45;color:#34536f;margin-top:7px">Annuaire numérique de l’inspection générale du Travail</div>
  <h2 id="igt-reg-title" style="color:#123d60;margin:8px 0">Créer un compte</h2>
  <p style="color:#5b6572;line-height:1.45">Tout agent de L’IGT peut créer librement son compte et accéder immédiatement à l’application.</p>
  <label style="display:block;font-weight:600;margin:12px 0 5px" for="igt-reg-name">Nom complet (nom, postnom et prénom)</label><input id="igt-reg-name" required maxlength="180" autocomplete="name" placeholder="Nom complet officiel" style="box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;padding:12px;border:1px solid #ccd4df;border-radius:9px;font-size:16px">
  <label style="display:block;font-weight:600;margin:12px 0 5px" for="igt-reg-category">Catégorie</label><select id="igt-reg-category" required style="box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;padding:12px;border:1px solid #ccd4df;border-radius:9px;font-size:16px;background:#fff"><option value="">Sélectionner votre catégorie</option><option value="inspecteur">Inspecteur du travail</option><option value="controleur">Contrôleur du travail</option><option value="agent_administratif">Agent administratif</option></select>
  <label style="display:block;font-weight:600;margin:12px 0 5px" for="igt-reg-matricule">Numéro matricule officiel</label><input id="igt-reg-matricule" required maxlength="80" placeholder="Votre matricule officiel" style="box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;padding:12px;border:1px solid #ccd4df;border-radius:9px;font-size:16px">
  <label style="display:block;font-weight:600;margin:12px 0 5px" for="igt-reg-phone">Numéro de téléphone</label><input id="igt-reg-phone" type="tel" required maxlength="30" autocomplete="tel" placeholder="Ex. +243 8XX XXX XXX" style="box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;padding:12px;border:1px solid #ccd4df;border-radius:9px;font-size:16px">
  <label style="display:block;font-weight:600;margin:12px 0 5px" for="igt-reg-address">Adresse physique complète</label><input id="igt-reg-address" required maxlength="240" autocomplete="street-address" placeholder="Commune, quartier, avenue, numéro" style="box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;padding:12px;border:1px solid #ccd4df;border-radius:9px;font-size:16px">
  <label style="display:block;font-weight:600;margin:12px 0 5px" for="igt-reg-email">Adresse e-mail personnelle</label><input id="igt-reg-email" type="email" required maxlength="254" autocomplete="email" placeholder="nom@exemple.com" style="box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;padding:12px;border:1px solid #ccd4df;border-radius:9px;font-size:16px">
  <label style="display:block;font-weight:600;margin:12px 0 5px" for="igt-reg-password">Créer un mot de passe (8 caractères minimum)</label><input id="igt-reg-password" type="password" required minlength="8" autocomplete="new-password" placeholder="Mot de passe personnel" style="box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;padding:12px;border:1px solid #ccd4df;border-radius:9px;font-size:16px">
  <label style="display:block;font-weight:600;margin:12px 0 5px" for="igt-reg-password2">Confirmer le mot de passe</label><input id="igt-reg-password2" type="password" required minlength="8" autocomplete="new-password" placeholder="Répéter le mot de passe" style="box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;padding:12px;border:1px solid #ccd4df;border-radius:9px;font-size:16px">
  <div style="position:absolute;left:-10000px" aria-hidden="true"><label for="igt-reg-website">Ne pas remplir</label><input id="igt-reg-website" tabindex="-1" autocomplete="off"></div>
  <div id="igt-reg-message" role="status" aria-live="polite" style="margin-top:12px;min-height:22px;font-size:14px"></div>
  <button id="igt-reg-submit" type="submit" style="width:100%;margin-top:12px;padding:13px;border:0;border-radius:9px;background:#0d4772;color:#fff;font-weight:700;font-size:15px">Créer mon compte</button>
  <button id="igt-close-registration" type="button" style="width:100%;margin-top:9px;padding:11px;border:1px solid #ccd4df;border-radius:9px;background:#fff;color:#334155;font-weight:600">Retour à la connexion</button>
 </form>
</div>
<div id="igt-auth-user" hidden aria-label="Profil du compte"></div>
<div id="igt-agent-tools" hidden style="position:fixed;right:14px;bottom:66px;z-index:99997;display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:flex-end;max-width:calc(100vw - 28px)">
 <button type="button" id="igt-open-inbox" style="border:0;border-radius:9px;background:#0876bd;color:#fff;padding:9px 12px;font-weight:700;box-shadow:0 3px 12px #0003">✉ Messages</button>
 <button type="button" id="igt-open-admin" hidden style="border:0;border-radius:9px;background:#d4a72c;color:#102b45;padding:9px 12px;font-weight:800;box-shadow:0 3px 12px #0003">⚙ Administration</button>
</div>
<div id="igt-workspace" hidden style="position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:1000010;background:#071b35dd;overflow:auto;padding:12px;box-sizing:border-box">
 <section style="max-width:1100px;margin:12px auto;background:#fff;color:#172334;border-radius:14px;padding:18px;box-shadow:0 20px 70px #0006;font-family:Arial,sans-serif">
  <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap"><div><small style="color:#b18a35;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:1px">ESPACE ADMINISTRATEUR UNIQUE</small><h2 style="margin:5px 0;color:#123d60">Administration ANI-IGT — Pmiller</h2><p style="margin:0;color:#64748b;font-size:13px">Gestion centralisée des comptes : inscription automatique, suspension et réactivation par Pmiller, présence et messagerie.</p></div><button type="button" id="igt-close-workspace" style="border:0;border-radius:8px;padding:9px 13px;background:#e8eef4;color:#24364a;font-weight:700">Fermer ✕</button></div>
  <div id="igt-admin-stats" style="display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:16px 0"></div>
  <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:12px 0"><input id="igt-admin-search" type="search" placeholder="Rechercher par nom, matricule, téléphone ou e-mail…" style="flex:1;min-width:230px;padding:11px;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-radius:8px"><datalist id="igt-admin-name-suggestions"></datalist><button id="igt-admin-refresh" type="button" style="padding:10px 13px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:#0876bd;color:white;font-weight:700">Rechercher</button><button id="igt-admin-suspend-all" type="button" style="padding:10px 13px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:#c63844;color:white;font-weight:700">Suspendre tous</button><button id="igt-admin-reactivate-all" type="button" style="margin-left:7px;padding:10px 13px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:#138a65;color:white;font-weight:700">Réactiver tous</button></div>
  <div id="igt-admin-feedback" role="status" style="font-size:13px;margin:8px 0;color:#075d94"></div>
  <div style="overflow:auto;border:1px solid #dce7f0;border-radius:9px"><table style="width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;min-width:760px;font-size:12px"><thead style="background:#edf6fc"><tr><th style="padding:10px;text-align:left">Agent</th><th style="padding:10px;text-align:left">Matricule</th><th style="padding:10px;text-align:left">Grade</th><th style="padding:10px;text-align:left">Fonction</th><th style="padding:10px;text-align:left">Direction / Service</th><th style="padding:10px;text-align:left">Lieu</th><th style="padding:10px;text-align:left">Province</th><th style="padding:10px;text-align:left">Téléphone</th><th style="padding:10px;text-align:left">Adresse physique</th><th style="padding:10px;text-align:left">E-mail</th><th style="padding:10px;text-align:left">État</th><th style="padding:10px;text-align:left">Présence</th><th style="padding:10px;text-align:left">Action</th></tr></thead><tbody id="igt-admin-users-body"><tr><td colspan="13" style="padding:15px">Chargement…</td></tr></tbody></table></div>
  <h3 style="margin:22px 0 8px;color:#123d60">Messagerie ciblée</h3>
  <p style="margin:0 0 8px;color:#64748b;font-size:12px">Sélectionnez un ou plusieurs agents pour leur envoyer le même message privé.</p>
  <select id="igt-message-targets" multiple size="5" aria-label="Sélectionner plusieurs agents" style="width:100%;padding:10px;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-radius:8px;min-height:110px;background:#fff"></select>
  <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:8px 0 14px"><button type="button" id="igt-message-select-all" style="padding:8px 11px;border:1px solid #bcd6e8;border-radius:7px;background:#edf7fd;color:#075d94;font-weight:700">Sélectionner tous les agents affichés</button><button type="button" id="igt-message-clear-selection" style="padding:8px 11px;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-radius:7px;background:#fff;color:#334155">Effacer la sélection</button><button type="button" id="igt-message-compose-selected" style="padding:8px 11px;border:0;border-radius:7px;background:#0876bd;color:#fff;font-weight:700">Écrire aux agents sélectionnés</button></div>
  <div id="igt-message-selection-feedback" role="status" style="font-size:12px;color:#075d94"></div>
  <h3 style="margin:22px 0 8px;color:#123d60">Envoyer une annonce</h3><div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:8px"><input id="igt-ann-title" maxlength="160" placeholder="Titre de l'annonce" style="padding:10px;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-radius:8px"><textarea id="igt-ann-body" maxlength="2500" rows="3" placeholder="Message destiné à tous les agents ou à un agent sélectionné" style="padding:10px;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-radius:8px"></textarea><select id="igt-ann-target" style="padding:10px;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-radius:8px"><option value="">Tous les agents</option></select><button type="button" id="igt-ann-send" style="padding:11px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:#0876bd;color:#fff;font-weight:700">Publier l'annonce</button></div>
  <h3 style="margin:22px 0 8px;color:#123d60">Historique administratif</h3><div style="display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:8px"><button type="button" id="igt-load-logs" style="padding:8px 11px;border:1px solid #bcd6e8;border-radius:7px;background:#edf7fd;color:#075d94;font-weight:700">Afficher l'historique</button><button type="button" id="igt-export-csv" style="padding:8px 11px;border:1px solid #bcd6e8;border-radius:7px;background:#edf7fd;color:#075d94;font-weight:700">Exporter Excel (CSV)</button><button type="button" id="igt-export-pdf" style="padding:8px 11px;border:1px solid #bcd6e8;border-radius:7px;background:#edf7fd;color:#075d94;font-weight:700">Imprimer / PDF</button></div><div id="igt-admin-logs" style="font-size:12px;color:#475569"></div>
 </section>
</div>
<div id="igt-inbox" hidden style="position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:1000011;background:#071b35dd;overflow:auto;padding:12px;box-sizing:border-box"><section style="max-width:760px;margin:20px auto;background:#fff;color:#172334;border-radius:14px;padding:18px;font-family:Arial,sans-serif"><div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px"><h2 style="margin:0;color:#123d60">Messagerie ANI-IGT</h2><button id="igt-close-inbox" type="button" style="padding:8px 12px;border:0;border-radius:7px">Fermer ✕</button></div><div id="igt-announcements-list" style="margin:12px 0"></div><div id="igt-messages-list" style="height:300px;overflow:auto;border:1px solid #dce7f0;border-radius:8px;padding:10px;margin:10px 0"></div><textarea id="igt-message-text" maxlength="2500" rows="3" placeholder="Écrire à l'administrateur (2 500 caractères maximum)…" style="width:100%;padding:10px;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-radius:8px;box-sizing:border-box"></textarea><button id="igt-message-send" type="button" style="margin-top:8px;padding:10px 14px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:#0876bd;color:white;font-weight:700">Envoyer le message</button><div id="igt-inbox-feedback" role="status" style="font-size:12px;margin-top:8px"></div></section></div>
<div class="shell"><aside class="side"><div class="brand"><div class="seal">⚖</div><div><b>Système d’identification numérique de l’IGT</b><small>Annuaire numérique du personnel • RDC</small></div></div><div class="nav"><div class="navtitle">ANNUAIRE NUMÉRIQUE</div><a class="active" onclick="toast('Tableau de bord chargé')"><span class="ico">▦</span>Tableau de bord</a><a onclick="openModal('missions')"><span class="ico">◈</span>Missions & compétences</a><a onclick="openModal('organisation')"><span class="ico">⌘</span>Organisation territoriale</a><a onclick="openModal('rdcmap')"><span class="ico">◉</span>Carte interactive RDC</a><a onclick="openModal('administratifs')"><span class="ico">♙</span>Agents administratifs (260)</a><a onclick="document.getElementById('personnel').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'})"><span class="ico">⌕</span>Registre des agents</a><a onclick="openModal('carte')"><span class="ico">▣</span>Cartes professionnelles</a><div class="navtitle">GESTION</div><a onclick="toast('Module Missions : accès selon vos habilitations')"><span class="ico">▧</span>Ordres de mission</a><a onclick="openModal('assistant')"><span class="ico">✦</span>Assistant IA IGT</a><div class="navtitle">SYSTÈME</div><a onclick="toast('Paramètres de sécurité')"><span class="ico">⚙</span>Administration</a></div><div class="account"><b>Administrateur IGT</b><small>● Session sécurisée</small></div></aside><main class="main"><header class="top igt-masthead">
 <div class="igt-brand-image"><img decoding="async" src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="République démocratique du Congo – Ministère de l’Emploi et du Travail – Inspection Générale du Travail"></div>
 <div class="igt-header-right">
  
  <button type="button" class="header-menu-toggle" id="igt-header-menu-toggle" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="igt-header-dropdown" aria-label="Ouvrir le menu">☰</button>
  <div class="header-dropdown" id="igt-header-dropdown" hidden>
   <div class="igt-dropdown-heading">Espace utilisateur</div>
   <div id="igt-menu-profile"></div>
   <div id="igt-menu-messages"></div>
   <div id="igt-menu-admin"></div>
   <a href="#portal-hero">Accueil</a>
   <a href="#service-search">Recherche du personnel</a>
   <a href="#igt-footer">Coordonnées</a>
  </div>
 </div>
</header><div class="content"><section class="hero-carousel" id="portal-hero"><div class="slides" id="hero-slides"><article class="hero-slide active" data-image="data:image/webp;base64,
